Class of vector Z is sign([W^T Z + 1]^d + b)

layout.arrangement: A single white slide framed by a thin red rectangle. Top row: a small white badge with blue border and blue italic text at top-left ('Example: Polynomial Kernel'), the large red bold title centered at the top ('How to Kernelize SVM'), and a yellow circular slide-number badge ('37') at the top-right. Below, a wide blue-outlined panel (upper panel) holds the original SVM objective, the W definition, the bias b formula, and a peach 'Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(...)' strip. In the vertical middle, a small white box reading 'Kernelize using' sits left of a red kernel formula, with a red downward block arrow beneath pointing into the lower panel. A second wide blue-outlined panel (lower panel) holds the kernelized objective, W, b, and a peach 'Class of vector Z is sign(...)' strip. A black letterbox bar (video artifact) runs along the very bottom edge.

typography_notes: Title is a large (~28-32 pt) bold sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like) in red, centered. The kicker 'Example: Polynomial Kernel' is smaller (~13-14 pt) blue italic sans-serif inside a thin blue-bordered white box, with 'Polynomial Kernel' in slightly bolder italic. 'Kernelize using' is italic serif (Times-like) in black. All mathematical expressions are set in a serif math face with italic variables, subscripts (i=1, j=1, i,y=−1, i,y=+1, D) and superscripts (N, T, d); the red kernel formula is bold serif. The 'Class of vector Z ...' strips use a plain sans-serif (Arial-like) in black with a green 'Z' and, in the upper strip, a red '⇒'. Green highlight rectangles are filled behind the emphasized math terms. No bullet glyphs are used anywhere.
animation_state: No visible mid-build state; all equations, highlights, the 'Kernelize using' connector and the arrow appear fully revealed. The green highlights are static emphasis, not animation artifacts.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide size to 16:9 (900x506 px reference) with a pure white background; add a thin red (#CC0000) rectangular outline inset about 6% from the left and right edges and 7.5% from the top and bottom edges. 2. Top-left: draw a white rectangle (~7.5%-32% x, ~9.5%-15% y) with a thin blue (#0000FF) border and type 'Example: Polynomial Kernel' in blue (#0000CC) italic sans-serif ~13 pt, with 'Polynomial Kernel' in bold italic. 3. Top-center: type 'How to Kernelize SVM' in bold red (#CC0000) sans-serif ~30 pt, centered around 35%-67% of the slide width. 4. Top-right: insert an oval (~4% wide) filled yellow (#FFFF99) with a thin black outline, containing the black text '37' centered, ~13 pt. 5. Draw the upper panel: white rectangle with thin blue outline spanning ~7.5%-92% x and ~18%-46% y. 6. In the upper panel, top row, type the objective 'ℒ_D(α) = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i − 1/2 Σ_{j=1}^{N} Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i α_j y_i y_j (X_i^T X_j)' in black serif math ~16 pt; place a light-green (#99FF99) rounded rectangle behind '(X_i^T X_j)' only. 7. Upper panel, middle-left: draw a small white rectangle with thin blue border (~16%-26% x, ~28%-38% y) containing 'W = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i y_i X_i' with a bold blue 'W' and black remainder. 8. Upper panel, middle-right: type 'b = − 1/2 [max_{i,y=−1} (W_i^T X_i) + min_{i,y=+1} (W_i^T X_i)]' in black serif math ~16 pt; place two light-green rounded rectangles behind each '(W_i^T X_i)'. 9. Upper panel, bottom: draw a peach (#FFE0C0) rectangle (~13%-51% x, ~38%-45% y) with no border and type 'Class of vector Z ⇒ sign(W^T Z + b)' in black sans-serif ~14 pt, with 'Z' in green (#00A000), '⇒' in red (#CC0000), and a light-green rounded rectangle behind 'W^T Z'. 10. Middle of slide: draw a small white rectangle (~30%-43% x, ~50%-55% y) with a thin gray border and type 'Kernelize using' in black italic serif ~13 pt; immediately to its right type 'K(α,b) = α^T b̂ + 1|^d' in bold red (#CC0000) serif ~14 pt (render the closing parenthesis as a vertical stroke before the superscript d, as in the original). 11. Add a downward block arrow (~2% wide, ~12% tall) centered under the red formula, red (#FF0000) outline with white fill, pointing into the lower panel. 12. Draw the lower panel: white rectangle with thin blue outline spanning ~7.5%-92% x and ~61%-91% y. 13. Lower panel, top row: type 'ℒ_D(α) = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i − 1/2 Σ_{j=1}^{N} Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i α_j y_i y_j (X_i^T X_j + 1)^d' in black serif math ~16 pt; place a light-green rounded rectangle behind '(X_i^T X_j + 1)^d'. 14. Lower panel, middle-left: repeat the small blue-bordered white box with 'W = Σ_{i=1}^{N} α_i y_i X_i'. 15. Lower panel, middle-right: type 'b = − 1/2 [max_{i,y=−1} [W_i^T X_i + 1]^d + min_{i,y=+1} [W_i^T X_i + 1]^d]' in black serif math ~16 pt; place two light-green rounded rectangles behind each '[W_i^T X_i + 1]^d'. 16. Lower panel, bottom: draw a peach rectangle (~13%-57% x, ~83%-90% y) and type 'Class of vector Z is sign([W^T Z + 1]^d + b)' in black sans-serif ~14 pt, with 'Z' in green and a light-green rounded rectangle behind '[W^T Z + 1]^d'. 17. Leave the bottom ~4% of the frame black (video letterbox artifact) if reproducing the captured frame; otherwise omit it. 18. Verify no bullet characters are used and that all subscripts/superscripts (N, T, d, i=1, j=1, i,y=−1, i,y=+1) are formatted as true sub/superscripts.
